title: Key with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Key bow (round head) -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="22" fill="#f5c542" />
  <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="16" fill="#f5a623" />
  <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="10" fill="#f5c542" />
  <!-- Key hole -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="4" fill="#2a1a00" />
  <!-- Shaft -->
  <rect x="50" y="44" width="34" height="12" rx="2" fill="#f5c542" />
  <rect x="50" y="46" width="34" height="8" rx="1" fill="#f5a623" />
  <!-- Teeth -->
  <rect x="74" y="56" width="6" height="12" rx="1" fill="#f5c542" />
  <rect x="74" y="56" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#f5a623" />
  <rect x="62" y="56" width="6" height="8" rx="1" fill="#f5c542" />
  <rect x="62" y="56" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#f5a623" />
  <!-- Smiling face on the bow -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="44" r="2.5" fill="#2a1a00" />
  <circle cx="38" cy="44" r="2.5" fill="#2a1a00" />
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="43" r="1" fill="#ffe9a0" />
  <circle cx="39" cy="43" r="1" fill="#ffe9a0" />
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 24 52 Q 32 60 40 52" stroke="#2a1a00" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="52" r="3" fill="#e88a2a" opacity="0.6" />
  <circle cx="42" cy="52" r="3" fill="#e88a2a" opacity="0.6" />
  <!-- Shine on bow -->
  <path d="M 18 38 Q 22 32 30 32" stroke="#ffe9a0" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7" />
  <!-- Shine on shaft -->
  <rect x="54" y="47" width="20" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffe9a0" opacity="0.6" />
</svg>
